```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ProcessConfig, process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack";
function main() {
  const config: ProcessConfig = { language: "c" };
  const result = process("#include <stdio.h>\n\nint main() {\n    printf(\"hello\");\n    return 0;\n}\n", config);
  console.log(result.language);
  console.log(result.structure);
  console.log(result.structure?.[0]?.kind);
  console.log(result.metrics?.totalLines);

}
```
